summary: A unique blend of merge gameplay, virtual pet & kingdom builder!
description:
Open yourself up to a new type of merge game, straight from a fairy tale! 
Royal Merge is the ultimate merging brain teaser. Match items, complete orders, marvel at the colorful, fairy-tale-like graphics and lose yourself in the virtual kingdom of addictive and relaxing merge gameplay. 

MAIN FEATURES:
- Fresh and exciting merge-2 gameplay
- Your own Dragon Pet!
- Kingdom Development and Customization
- Challenging events & unique Puzzle Collections

The once-peaceful land, destroyed by unfriendly Dragons, needs your help! 

Prepare for a colorful, engaging merge game that is easy to understand, but offers plenty of depth and challenge. Relax and immerse yourself in a fascinating gameplay, but plan your course of action carefully and use the best strategy to help your realm reach its full potential that will stand the test of time.

Design, rebuild, and decorate your own Kingdom. Uncover hidden, beautiful places, different maps and new characters. Unlock customizable buildings and decorate your magical fairytale empire to make it a place of dreams. Transform breathtaking wildlands into something magical. 

Hatch and grow your own Dragon, take care of him and he will help you get more rewards! 

Keep your Dragon happy and let him take part in adventurous events. You never know what awaits behind the corner of your Kingdom. It’s time to kick off your journey; the Royal Merge awaits!
